This compound is implicated in the regulation of Hs746T, indicating a potential pathway where gamma-Glutamylhistidine may influence Hs746T through its interaction with the estrogen receptor. The evidence suggests that gamma-Glutamylhistidine could act as a modulator of the signaling cascade initiated by the estrogen receptor, potentially affecting Hs746T through a series of molecular interactions. The integration of these pathways highlights the role of the estrogen receptor in mediating the effects of gamma-Glutamylhistidine on Hs746T, emphasizing the importance of G-protein coupled receptors in this relationship.
